profile.name: 计算节点服务器
profile.description: 用于实验室分布式计算或数据处理集群的节点服务器软件，通常运行在联网计算机上，用于发现任务分发端、申请处理任务并可被停止或关闭。
profile.description_en: A node server used in laboratory distributed computing or data-processing clusters. It typically runs on a networked computer to discover a task distributor, request work, and be stopped or shut down when needed.

A node server used in laboratory distributed computing or data-processing clusters. It typically runs on a networked computer to discover a task distributor, request work, and be stopped or shut down when needed.
